outcome.audience: AI-native founders operating a production agent from a web product
outcome.statement: Submit an approved task from a Vercel cockpit to a Railway operator and receive a durable, inspectable run receipt without exposing operator credentials to the browser.
acceptanceCriteria: The browser never receives the Railway operator URL credential or service token.

After completion, the same valid idempotency key and identical full request resolve to one stored receipt; crash recovery may reattempt only that identical request with at-least-once execution semantics.
The cockpit can submit a bounded run and retrieve its completed receipt without receiving Railway control-plane credentials.
Authentication, operator health, and receipt persistence fail closed.

surfaces.name: Launchpad web cockpit
responsibilities: Collect and validate a bounded task request.
Enforce human approval before the server submits a run.
Render operator health and the completed receipt.

environment.name: RAILWAY_API_URL
environment.purpose: Authenticated public HTTPS origin for the Railway operator; never a railway.internal hostname.

environment.name: RAILWAY_API_TOKEN
environment.purpose: Server-only credential used by the Vercel route handler to authenticate to the operator.

environment.name: COCKPIT_ACCESS_TOKEN
environment.purpose: Credential that gates access to the cockpit before any run can be submitted.

environment.name: APP_ORIGIN
environment.purpose: Canonical HTTPS origin used for same-origin and callback validation.

surfaces.name: Launchpad operator project
responsibilities: Execute the bounded core operator contract.
Persist run state and signed, durable, idempotent receipts.
Expose health and receipt retrieval over authenticated public HTTPS.

environment.name: OPERATOR_API_KEY
environment.purpose: Railway-side copy of the service token accepted by the operator API.

environment.name: RECEIPT_SIGNING_SECRET
environment.purpose: Key used by the operator to bind a receipt to its canonical run payload.

environment.name: RECEIPT_SIGNING_KEY_ID
environment.purpose: Stable non-secret identifier for the receipt signing key used by verifiers.

environment.name: DATABASE_URL
environment.purpose: Private Railway PostgreSQL connection used for durable run and receipt persistence.

connections.purpose: Create a bounded run and return its signed, durable receipt after the bounded execution completes.
Retrieve a completed receipt by its receipt identifier without exposing the operator credential to the browser.

adapters.purpose: Optional reasoning adapter behind the core operator contract; not part of the v0.1 proof.
Optional deterministic workflow adapter behind the core operator contract; not part of the v0.1 proof.

irreversibleActions: Submit a task that can write outside the operator receipt store.
Rotate or reveal an operator credential.
Publish, message, purchase, delete, or deploy through an optional adapter.

recovery.rollback: Redeploy the last known-good Vercel and Railway project revisions independently.
recovery.stateBackup: Back up the Railway receipt store daily and verify a restore before promotion.

checks.expected: The manifest passes structural and semantic validation.
The Vercel cockpit compiles from its pinned source ref.
The Railway operator and receipt store compile from their pinned source ref.
The deployed cockpit health route returns its declared success status.
The deployed operator health route returns its declared success status without leaking secrets.
An approved Vercel request creates one Railway run and returns a matching durable receipt.
No operator URL credential or service token appears in browser bundles, responses, or logs.
Missing or invalid service credentials fail closed without creating a run or receipt.
The cockpit rolls back independently while existing Railway receipts remain readable.
The operator rolls back independently without corrupting existing receipts.
